title: Practice: write a forked review skill, a manual release skill and a command, and place the rest of the guidance (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 the review skill is a forked skill with an explicit task and an argument
cases.says: The review skill is forked, uses general-purpose, has numbered steps with $0, and an argument-hint

cases.id: e1 the release skill is started only by a person and pre approves patterns
cases.says: The release skill is manual, takes $version, and pre-approves only the two patterns

cases.id: e2 tools are taken away with disallowed tools and allowed tools only pre approves
cases.says: disallowed-tools removes Edit and Write from the review, and allowed-tools is patterns only, so nothing is mistaken for a restriction

cases.id: e3 arguments fill the placeholders of every file
cases.says: Arguments fill the placeholders of all three files, and the command receives $ARGUMENTS

cases.id: e4 every file creates its own slash command and the personal variant has a new name
cases.says: Every file creates its own slash command and the personal variant has a new name

cases.id: e5 each piece of guidance lives where it loads the way it is used
cases.says: Each of the five pieces of guidance sits where it loads the way it is used

cases.id: e6 every skill says when to use it and stays inside the listing budget
cases.says: Every skill says when to use it and stays inside the listing budget

cases.id: e7 no file holds a personal path an address or a key
cases.says: No file holds a personal path, an address or a key
